Implement `pack_symbols(text)` and `unpack_symbols(encoded)` in `solution.py` using only the standard library.

The supported alphabet is the exact string `ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789.,?`. Its zero-based index, written as two decimal digits, is the code for a character: `A` is `00`, `Z` is `25`, and `?` is `38`.

`pack_symbols` must require a string, convert supported letters case-insensitively, and skip unsupported non-whitespace characters. One or more whitespace characters delimit words. Codes within a word are joined by `|`; encoded words are joined by `/`. Words containing no supported characters are omitted. Empty or entirely unsupported input returns `""`.

`unpack_symbols` must require a string. Split words on `/` and tokens on `|`. A token is valid only if it consists of exactly two ASCII decimal digits and denotes a supported index. Invalid tokens and empty words are skipped. Decoded words are joined by one ordinary space. Empty or entirely malformed input returns `""`.

Neither function mutates any input.

import unittest

from solution import pack_symbols, unpack_symbols


class SymbolCodecTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_pack_known_codes_and_case_insensitivity(self):
        self.assertEqual(pack_symbols("Az 09.?,"), "00|25/26|35|36|38|37")
        self.assertEqual(pack_symbols("aBc"), "00|01|02")

    def test_pack_word_delimiters_and_unsupported_characters(self):
        self.assertEqual(pack_symbols("  A!b\t---\nC@D  "), "00|01/02|03")
        self.assertEqual(pack_symbols("A-$-B ### C"), "00|01/02")
        self.assertEqual(pack_symbols(""), "")
        self.assertEqual(pack_symbols(" !@# \t -_ "), "")

    def test_unpack_valid_and_mixed_tokens(self):
        self.assertEqual(unpack_symbols("00|25/26|35|36|37|38"), "AZ 09.,?")
        self.assertEqual(unpack_symbols("00|xx|01/99|02/03|"), "AB C D")
        self.assertEqual(unpack_symbols("/00//01/"), "A B")

    def test_unpack_requires_exact_ascii_two_digit_tokens(self):
        self.assertEqual(unpack_symbols("0|000|+1| 01|01 |٣٨|39/38"), "?")
        self.assertEqual(unpack_symbols(""), "")
        self.assertEqual(unpack_symbols("bad||99///"), "")

    def test_type_errors(self):
        for value in [None, 123, b"ABC", ["A"]]:
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    pack_symbols(value)
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    unpack_symbols(value)

    def test_strings_are_unchanged(self):
        text = "Ab! C?"
        encoded = "00|01/02|38"
        pack_symbols(text)
        unpack_symbols(encoded)
        self.assertEqual(text, "Ab! C?")
        self.assertEqual(encoded, "00|01/02|38")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
